name: append-to-page
description: Appends plain text to the end of a Notion page, each non-empty line a block: '# ' to '### ' headings, '- ' bulleted and '1. ' numbered items, '[ ] ' and '[x] ' to-dos, '> ' quotes, any other line a paragraph; at most 100 lines of up to 200,000 characters each. The page id or URL comes from notion__search-pages-and-databases or notion__get-page. Answers appended and the new blocks' ids.

pageId.description: A Notion page ID or page URL.

content.description: Plain text to append. Each non-empty line becomes a block.
